outcome: The object moves from its current zone to the exile zone and the card is then an exiled card.
A card exiled face down has no characteristics, and when played from exile it is turned face up just before it is cast, unless it is cast face down.
A spell may be cast from among face-down exiled cards only if the player may look at the card and the resulting spell has the specified qualities.
A linked ability refers only to the cards exiled by the first ability of the same object, not to cards exiled by other effects.
An exiled card that is exiled again does not change zones but becomes a new object that has just been exiled, so it loses its link to earlier effects.
